I’ll check off-peak cups, so when we’re staffed and the line is under six, make the note specific to the customer—not just a smiley.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate wants a personal note on every cup when it’s calm, so please make that part of the off-peak routine and I’ll check in on it. With the call-out and that line this morning, skip notes while we’re backed up or short-staffed—just get drinks out safely.

managers.private_thought: Corporate can check off-peak later, but I’m not making this crew choose between a cup note and keeping an airport line moving.
